snippet.title: It Commands - Indie Horror Game (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Our Discord Server: https://discord.gg/cg2sFPqen9
Our Patreon Page: https://www.patreon.com/horrorgamesx

It Commands is a horror game with humor elements developed by Amaakir where you are in your living room with a strange creature that asks you to do its bidding or it will eat you.
